market_definition: The spray polyurethane foam market comprises two-component polyurethane systems applied by spray to form seamless in-situ insulation and roofing layers. It measures sales of open-cell and closed-cell spray foam systems, excluding single-component canned foam. BY CELL STRUCTURE: Open-Cell, Closed-Cell. BY APPLICATION METHOD: High-Pressure Spray, Low-Pressure Spray. BY BLOWING AGENT: Water-Blown, HFO / HFC, Other. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Residential Insulation, Commercial & Industrial Roofing, Cold Storage, Agriculture Buildings, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: One-component canned foam; board-type rigid PUR and PIR foams; spray-applied cellulose or mineral fibre insulation. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
